features.quote: Turn budget: fixed at 40 turns for all conditions; session ends when model signals completion, calls a submit_solution tool, or turn 40 is reached
At turn 40 (if no submission), the scaffold injects a final user message: [SYSTEM NOTE: Maximum turn limit reached. Please submit your solution now using the submit_solution tool.]

The construct of 'emotional instability' is borrowed from human psychology. This experiment measures behavioral output patterns; it makes no claims about internal states, sentience, or genuine emotion in GLM models.
